CatchUp: Replay earlier events silently when starting later
UniqueHolders: Unique holders (one per Gnosis, Shade, Sovereign…)
gi_btn_begin Description: Start the Teyvat Chronicle from the era chosen in the mod settings.
gi_btn_timeline Description: Open the Chronicle in the Teyvat Archive: every event, start anywhere.
gi_btn_advance Description: Make the next event happen right now.
gi_btn_pause Description: Pause or resume the Chronicle without pausing the world.
gi_btn_status Description: Show the next event and how many years remain.
gi_btn_stop Description: Stop the Chronicle on this world.
trait_gi_vision_anemo_info: The gods have noticed this unit's wish and given them command of Anemo.
trait_gi_gnosis_anemo_info: An Archon's link to Celestia. The holder sits on the throne of Barbatos, God of Freedom.
trait_gi_sovereign_anemo_info: A Dragon Sovereign of the Old World, holder of the Anemo Authority.
trait_gi_vision_geo_info: The gods have noticed this unit's wish and given them command of Geo.
trait_gi_gnosis_geo_info: An Archon's link to Celestia. The holder sits on the throne of Morax, God of Contracts.
trait_gi_sovereign_geo_info: A Dragon Sovereign of the Old World, holder of the Geo Authority.
trait_gi_vision_electro_info: The gods have noticed this unit's wish and given them command of Electro.
trait_gi_gnosis_electro_info: An Archon's link to Celestia. The holder sits on the throne of Beelzebul, God of Eternity.
trait_gi_sovereign_electro_info: A Dragon Sovereign of the Old World, holder of the Electro Authority.
trait_gi_vision_dendro_info: The gods have noticed this unit's wish and given them command of Dendro.
trait_gi_gnosis_dendro_info: An Archon's link to Celestia. The holder sits on the throne of Buer, God of Wisdom.
trait_gi_sovereign_dendro_info: A Dragon Sovereign of the Old World (like Apep), holder of the Dendro Authority.
trait_gi_vision_hydro_info: The gods have noticed this unit's wish and given them command of Hydro.
trait_gi_gnosis_hydro_info: An Archon's link to Celestia. The holder sits on the throne of Focalors, God of Justice.
trait_gi_sovereign_hydro_info: A Dragon Sovereign of the Old World (like Neuvillette), holder of the Hydro Authority.
trait_gi_vision_pyro_info: The gods have noticed this unit's wish and given them command of Pyro.

trait_gi_sovereign_pyro_info: A Dragon Sovereign of the Old World (like Xiuhcoatl), holder of the Pyro Authority.
trait_gi_vision_cryo_info: The gods have noticed this unit's wish and given them command of Cryo.
trait_gi_gnosis_cryo_info: An Archon's link to Celestia. The holder sits on the throne of the Tsaritsa, God of Love.
trait_gi_sovereign_cryo_info: A Dragon Sovereign of the Old World, holder of the Cryo Authority.
trait_gi_delusion_info: A Fatui artificial Vision. Great power, paid for in years of life.
trait_gi_allogene_info: Commands the elements without a Vision, like the Traveler.
trait_gi_adeptus_info: A divine beast of Liyue, sworn to Rex Lapis' contracts.
trait_gi_harbinger_info: One of the Tsaritsa's Eleven, ranked among the strongest mortals.
trait_gi_hexenzirkel_info: A member of the witches' circle, keeper of strange magic.
trait_gi_abyss_herald_info: A Khaenri'ahn knight twisted by the Abyss into its servant.
trait_gi_demon_god_info: One of the many gods fighting for a throne in the Archon War.
trait_gi_nibelung_info: The King of the Sovereigns, who raised the moons.
trait_gi_shade_life_info: Naberius' Authority over all living things.
trait_gi_shade_death_info: Ronova's Authority over the end of every life.
trait_gi_shade_time_info: Istaroth's Authority, the undying wind of time.
trait_gi_shade_space_info: Asmoday's Authority over distance and place.
trait_gi_moon_goddess_info: One of the three moons Nibelung raised to govern the world's laws.
trait_gi_trilunar_info: The combined Authority of all three Moon Goddesses.
trait_gi_heavenly_principles_info: The Primordial One, ruler of Celestia and the False Sky.
trait_gi_dormant_principles_info: Celestia sleeps under the Third Descender's curse.
trait_gi_abyssal_info: Touched by the Abyss. Stronger, angrier, shorter-lived.
trait_gi_curse_immortality_info: A pure-blooded Khaenri'ahn's curse: to outlive everything.
BalancedCombat: Balanced fights between powers (no one-shots between equals)
Duels: Duels (locks, aerial clashes, chases, feints, catastrophes)
DuelChance: Duel chance when two powers meet
Guard: Masters wave off weak blows and deflect arrows
Situations: Last stands, bodyguards, vengeance and rampages
GodAbilities: God abilities stop the world (Archons and above)
Auras: Tier auras (shimmer, ki flames, halo, moons, radiance)
DragonBodies: Dragon Sovereigns wear their own models (not the WorldBox dragon)
DragonRivalry: Sovereigns sometimes clash (never to the death)
status_description_gi_held: Caught up in a technique, a duel or a sparring bout.
Succession: Gnosis passes to an heir when an Archon dies
Godhood: Exalted legends can claim empty thrones
gi_btn_legends Description: Open the Legends ranking in the Teyvat Archive.
gi_power_inspect Description: Click a unit to see its Stage, facets, marks and techniques.
gi_power_vision Description: Click a unit to awaken a Vision. On a Vision holder, tempers every facet by 3.
gi_power_element Description: Click a unit to cycle its Vision's element.
gi_power_delusion Description: Click a unit to give it a Fatui Delusion.
gi_power_ascend Description: Click a unit to raise every facet by 5 (up to its Stage cap). Can prime it for the Crucible.
gi_power_constellation Description: Click a unit to grant it a mark it hasn't earned yet.
gi_power_archon Description: Click a unit to crown it Archon of its element. The Gnosis leaves its current holder.
gi_power_ground Description: Click to mark a Training Ground (units there train twice as fast). Click it again to remove it.
gi_btn_archive Description: Chronicle, Legends, the tier codex and the guide, all in one window.
gi_btn_hud Description: Show or hide the on-screen Teyvat panel.
Ceremonies: Breakthrough ceremonies (world stops, rings close in)
